title: Durable workspace authority reconciliation — pre-fix reproduction (T-1788346430756 closed with incomplete validation)

stable_facts.note: registry autoincrement drifts across fresh restart (144 -> 156 observed); instance id is the only stable cross-DB key

status_instance_key.verdict: PASS (instance-key path resolves task-DB via workspace_authority_captures)

status_numeric_key_pre_fix.verdict: FAIL — task_db_workspace_id/task_db_instance_id null after restart (registry id drift broke the alias lookup)

status_legacy_ws1.verdict: partial — task-DB-only historical binding surfaced (registry side absent; acceptable for read)

status_taskdb_id_1.verdict: partial — numeric collision between registry id=1 (instance 00f5..) and task-DB id=1 (instance ws-1); different instances (phantom overlap, not a runtime authority)

numeric_key_path: task_db_capture_by_id(156) -> None (no task-DB capture row with workspace_id=156)
alias_by_any_id(156) -> None (workspace_reconciliation_aliases stores registry_workspace_id=144, now stale after drift to 156)
root_cause.summary: The numeric-key status path never cross-references the STABLE instance id, so a drifted registry numeric id yields a null task-DB side. The prior task only validated the instance-key path, leaving the numeric-key path broken across restart.

fix_plan.change: In resolve_status_authority, after resolving the registry instance (numeric or instance key), always re-resolve the task-DB side via task_db_capture_by_instance(instance) and alias_by_instance(instance). This makes the unified view durable across registry numeric-id drift and daemon restart.

negative_matrix_preconditions.registry_only_orphan: workspace registered with no task-DB capture -> task.create must fail-closed (E_WORKSPACE_AUTHORITY_MISMATCH), no partial rows
negative_matrix_preconditions.cross_project_or_unknown_instance: task.create with an instance absent from task-DB captures and workspaces -> fail-closed
negative_matrix_preconditions.stale_registry_id: task.create with stale numeric id + valid instance -> deterministically reconciled to task_db id via alias (by design)
negative_matrix_preconditions.historical_ws1: task.create with instance ws-1 -> audited reconciliation to task_db id=1 (no synthetic inference)
